name: COMP_018
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (77%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Flagged for low reliability [F6], Normal remains in the prediction set [F1], and frozen-section margins defer to permanent [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Top probabilities | InSitu 77%, Normal 15%, Invasive 6%, Benign 1% (ECE 5%) | Favors InSitu, low invasive risk |
| Conformal set | {Normal, InSitu} (90% target; 90% test coverage) | Cannot separate InSitu from Normal |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.30 / 100th percentile (flagged; error AUROC 0.70) | Out-of-distribution input, suspect read |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Disagree on top class | Independent foundation models conflict |
| Similar cases | 0/5 match InSitu [F5] (2 Benign, 2 Invasive, 1 Normal) | No neighbor support for InSitu |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 9, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Strongest negative contribution (-0.90) [F2], but 0/20 spot check is unreliable · Unreliable
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 1) · context · Below-typical score (-0.22, contribution +0.67) [F3]; 8/20 AI spot check · Weak
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 3, 6, 7) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (-0.47 contribution) [F4]; 12/20 AI spot check · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 0) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.29 contribution); weak concept with 0/20 spot check, unreliable · Unreliable
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 9) · ↓ invasive · Below-average score (-0.24 contribution) reduces invasive probability; 19/20 AI spot check · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to the classifier; removing top-risk regions drops invasive probability more than random (+0.011, 95% CI 0.002 to 0.020).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion CI -0.009 to 0.006 includes 0) and relies on unreliable normal_lobules and mitoses (0/20 spot checks).

## Could be wrong if
- Artifact or out-of-distribution staining (100th percentile) masks true morphology; closest reference cases are Benign (83% similarity) or Invasive.
- Focal invasion exists in high-risk region 8 (89% risk), or atypical ducts represent Normal tissue within the conformal set.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 8, 2, 4**: Inspect highest-risk tiles (89%, 21%, 7% risk) to rule out focal stromal invasion.
2. **Regions 3, 6, 7**: Verify duct-confined atypia versus normal epithelium; consider deeper levels as drafted.
3. **Regions 9, 10, 11**: Check lobules directly (unreliable 0/20 concept); consider recut H&E and defer frozen margins.
